name: callTool
description: Invoke one tool on a connected native MCP server via a `tools/call` JSON-RPC request over the server's stdio transport. `arguments` is the model-supplied tool input (already JSON-validated against the tool's inputSchema upstream in JS). Returns the raw MCP result envelope. Output: { ok: boolean, result?: object, error?: string }.

inputs.name: serverId
inputs.description: Opaque id of a connected native server.

inputs.name: toolName
inputs.description: Name of the tool to invoke (as advertised by the server's tools/list).

inputs.name: arguments
inputs.description: Tool arguments — a JSON object matching the tool's inputSchema. May be an empty object when the tool takes no inputs.
